explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 35 configurations over 8 sweeps (topology, ep-off, pipeline, batch-caps, moe-collective, routing-prefix-cache, prefill-chunking, cudagraph), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 64 GPUs.
4x TP4xPP4 + EP, from the pipeline sweep, reached 25.84 tok/s/accelerator (1653.6 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 512 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
4x TP4xPP4 + EP at concurrency 512. 140 of 140 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per accelerator, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: Eight TP8 instances should peak highest, since a 64-wide EP group pays all-to-all on every step for little extra batch.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 + EP at 23.46 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: topology

prose: Replicating experts instead of sharding them should cost KV room and throughput against the EP twins in topology.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 at 17.43 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: ep-off

prose: Pipeline stages should trail data-parallel shapes of the same width, since each stage adds a boundary hop per step.
Measured: best was 4x TP4xPP4 + EP at 25.84 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 512).
sections.title: Sweep: pipeline

prose: A seq cap of 32 should bind on 8x TP8 at 512 lanes but not on 2x TP8 DP4, whose dp ranks each schedule their own batch.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 + EP (max seqs 256 · batch tokens 32,768) at 23.73 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: batch-caps

prose: DeepEP backends should pay off at EP width 64 and matter little at width 8, where dispatch volume is small.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 + EP at 23.46 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: moe-collective

prose: prefix-affinity should only beat queue and random with caching on, and eight instances give it the most room to win.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 + EP (prefix-affinity routing) at 23.07 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: routing-prefix-cache

prose: Capping long prefills should trade a little peak throughput for a much lower ITL p99 at saturation.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 + EP at 23.3 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: prefill-chunking

prose: FULL capture should beat the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 + EP (graph capture full) at 23.72 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 256).
sections.title: Sweep: cudagraph
